nodes.description: Immutable address holding the proxy admin; only a caller equal to ADMIN may pass the ifAdmin gate, otherwise execution falls back into the delegatecall path.
EIP-1967 storage slot constant that stores the implementation address used by the proxy delegatecall.
Caller address; compared against ADMIN in the ifAdmin modifier and in _willFallback guards, and therefore the key access-control input.
Constructor that forwards the admin address to BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.
Fallback pre-hook override that delegates to the base implementation's _willFallback.
Constructor that writes the admin address into the immutable ADMIN state variable.
External admin-gated getter that returns the ADMIN immutable address.
External admin-gated getter returning the current implementation address from the EIP-1967 slot.
Admin-only function that upgrades the proxy implementation via _upgradeTo.
Admin-only payable function that upgrades the implementation and then performs a delegatecall into the new implementation with caller-supplied data.
Fallback guard that reverts when msg.sender equals the proxy ADMIN before delegating to super._willFallback.
Internal view that reads the implementation address from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT using inline assembly sload.
Internal function that writes the new implementation and emits the Upgraded event.
Internal function that validates the new implementation is a contract and stores it into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT with inline assembly sstore.
Payable fallback entry point that unconditionally routes execution into _fallback.
Internal function performing the raw delegatecall to the implementation address with full calldata and return-data bubbling.
Virtual empty fallback pre-hook intended to be overridden by derived proxies.
Internal fallback implementation that calls _willFallback then _delegate(_implementation()).
Library helper that checks extcodehash of an address to decide whether it is a deployed contract.
Library helper that forwards native value to a recipient using a low-level call, transferring all available gas.
Payable initializer that sets the implementation and delegatecalls initialization data into it exactly once (implementation must be zero).
Low-level delegatecall into a caller-supplied newImplementation with caller-supplied data, executed after the implementation slot is overwritten.
Raw inline-assembly delegatecall that forwards all gas and calldata to the implementation and bubbles return data or reverts.
Delegatecall of externally supplied _data into the newly set _logic implementation during initialization.
Inline-assembly sstore that writes the implementation address into the EIP-1967 slot.
Low-level value call to an arbitrary recipient, forwarding all available gas and enabling reentrancy on the recipient side.
Inline-assembly extcodehash read used for contract-existence detection (returns false for EOAs and contracts under construction).
Admin address passed up to the BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
Address parameter forwarded to _upgradeTo in upgradeTo.
Address parameter used both as the new implementation and as the delegatecall target in upgradeToAndCall.
Calldata blob forwarded to the delegatecall inside upgradeToAndCall.
Implementation address used as the delegatecall target in _delegate.
Address whose extcodehash is inspected in isContract.
Payable address that receives the forwarded value in sendValue.
Wei amount forwarded to recipient and checked against the contract balance.
Logic address stored as the new implementation and used as the delegatecall target during initialization.
Initialization calldata delegatecalled into the new logic contract.
Local bytes32 holding IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT for the sload in _implementation.
Local address receiving the result of the sload from the implementation slot.
Boolean capturing the result of the delegatecall and enforced by require.
Local bytes32 receiving extcodehash(account).
Local constant holding keccak256('') used to detect accounts without code.

edges.reason: admin() returns the ADMIN immutable state variable.
ADMIN is compared with msg.sender in the require guard of _willFallback.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the slot read by sload in _implementation.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the slot written by sstore in _setImplementation.
initialize asserts the keccak-derived value matches IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
ifAdmin modifier branches on msg.sender == ADMIN before admin() executes.
ifAdmin modifier branches on msg.sender == ADMIN before implementation() executes.
ifAdmin modifier branches on msg.sender == ADMIN before upgradeTo executes.
ifAdmin modifier branches on msg.sender == ADMIN before upgradeToAndCall executes.
_willFallback reverts when msg.sender is the proxy admin, gating the fallback path.
Any non-admin msg.sender reaching the fallback function is routed into the delegatecall path.
The overridden _willFallback invokes the base implementation explicitly.
upgradeTo calls _upgradeTo with the new implementation.
upgradeToAndCall calls _upgradeTo before performing the delegatecall.
upgradeToAndCall performs an external delegatecall into caller-supplied code after overwriting the implementation slot.
_upgradeTo delegates the storage write to _setImplementation.
_setImplementation validates the new implementation through Address.isContract.
_setImplementation writes the implementation via inline assembly sstore.
The fallback function calls _fallback.
_fallback invokes the _willFallback pre-hook before delegating.
_fallback delegates to _delegate with the resolved implementation.
_fallback resolves the implementation address via _implementation().
_willFallback in BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy chains to super._willFallback.

_delegate executes a raw delegatecall that hands full control to the implementation contract.
isContract performs the extcodehash inline assembly read.
sendValue transfers value with a low-level call to an arbitrary recipient, allowing reentrant code execution.
initialize delegatecalls caller-supplied _data into the newly set logic, executing external code in proxy storage context.

The newImplementation parameter of upgradeToAndCall flows into _upgradeTo.

The account parameter is the input to the extcodehash unsafe operation.
The recipient parameter is the destination of the low-level value call.
The amount parameter is the value forwarded by the low-level call.

_data is the payload forwarded to the initialization delegatecall.
